label: 烘焙动画 clip
description: 把作者关节轨迹 q(t)（以 URDF 关节名为键的每关节标量数组，弧度/米）校验后写入 Geometry 的 animation 语句，并在 animation 端口输出已解析的 clip。q(t) 来源优先级：motion 端口 > q_json 完整逐帧 JSON > keyframes 稀疏关键帧 > q_path 项目文件。何时用：想让导出的 GLB 播放手写 / 重定向的关节动画，而不是程序化预览。**在对话里让 agent 加动画时优先用 keyframes**——只需给每个关节几个「关键时刻的值」（如「0 秒抬到 0，1 秒放到 1.57」），电池按 fps/duration 采样、关键帧间插值展开成逐帧数组，不必手打或生成几百帧的完整数组。校验失败时几何原样透传、error 返回错误，不中断整条链路。
description-en: Validate authored joint trajectories q(t) (per-joint scalar arrays keyed by URDF joint name, radians/meters) and append an `animation` statement to the Geometry, also emitting the parsed clip on the `animation` port. q(t) source priority: `motion` port > `q_json` full per-frame JSON > `keyframes` sparse keyframes > `q_path` project file. Use when you want the exported GLB to play a hand-authored / retargeted joint animation instead of the procedural preview. **Prefer `keyframes` when an agent is authoring the animation from a chat description** — give a handful of {t, q} points per joint (e.g. "raise to 0 at t=0, to 1.57 at t=1") and the battery samples/interpolates them into the full per-frame array, so nobody has to hand-type or generate hundreds of frames. On validation failure the geometry passes through unchanged and `error` carries the message so the chain never breaks.

inputs.name: geometry
inputs.label: 几何
inputs.description: 上游 Geometry（提供 URDF 关节以对齐 q(t)）
inputs.description-en: Upstream Geometry (supplies URDF joints to align q(t) against).

inputs.name: motion
inputs.label: 运动 q(t)
inputs.description: q(t) 端口：JointAnimationClip 对象或 JSON 字符串（为将来的重定向 / 步态节点预留，优先级最高）
inputs.description-en: q(t) port: a JointAnimationClip object or JSON string (reserved for future retarget/gait nodes; highest priority).

inputs.name: q_json
inputs.label: q(t) 完整 JSON
inputs.description: 完整逐帧 q(t) JSON：{ "channels": { 关节名: number[] }, "fps"?, "frameCount"?, "loop"? }。每个 channel 数组长度必须等于 frameCount——手写小 clip 才用这个，动作复杂时优先用 keyframes
inputs.description-en: Full per-frame q(t) JSON: { "channels": { jointName: number[] }, "fps"?, "frameCount"?, "loop"? }. Each channel array length must equal frameCount — use this only for small hand-written clips; prefer `keyframes` for anything non-trivial.

inputs.name: keyframes
inputs.label: 稀疏关键帧
inputs.description: 稀疏关键帧 JSON：{ 关节名: [{"t":秒,"q":值}, ...], ... }（键=URDF 关节名；值弧度 revolute/continuous | 米 prismatic）。按 fps/duration 均匀采样，关键帧之间按 interpolation 插值；每个关节的点会自动按 t 排序。仅当 motion 与 q_json 都为空时使用——**agent 对话描述动作时的首选输入**，比手打/生成逐帧数组更省 token、更不容易出错。
inputs.description-en: Sparse keyframes JSON: { jointName: [{"t":sec,"q":value}, ...], ... } (key = URDF joint name; value in radians for revolute/continuous, meters for prismatic). Sampled uniformly by fps/duration, interpolated between keyframes per `interpolation`; each joint's points are sorted by t automatically. Used only when both `motion` and `q_json` are empty — **the preferred input when an agent is authoring the motion from a chat description**, far cheaper and more reliable than hand-typing or generating a full per-frame array.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.label: 时长（秒）
inputs.description: 仅 keyframes 生效：clip 总时长（秒）；0 或省略 = 自动取所有关键帧里最大的 t
inputs.description-en: Only applies to `keyframes`: total clip duration in seconds; 0 or omitted = auto (max `t` across all keyframes).

inputs.name: interpolation
inputs.label: 插值方式
inputs.description: 仅 keyframes 生效："linear"（关键帧间线性插值，默认）或 "step"（保持前一个关键帧的值直到下一个，适合开合/切换类动作）
inputs.description-en: Only applies to `keyframes`: "linear" (interpolate between keyframes, default) or "step" (hold the previous keyframe's value until the next; good for open/close or toggle-style motions).

inputs.name: q_path
inputs.label: q(t) 文件路径
inputs.description: 项目相对（或绝对）路径的 q(t) JSON 文件；仅当 motion、q_json、keyframes 都为空时读取
inputs.description-en: Project-relative (or absolute) path to a q(t) JSON file; read only when `motion`, `q_json`, and `keyframes` are all empty.

inputs.name: name
inputs.label: clip 名
inputs.description: 覆盖 clip 名；空 = 用 q(t) 里的 name（也可为空）
inputs.description-en: Override the clip name; empty = keep the q(t)'s name (may be empty).

inputs.name: fps
inputs.label: 帧率
inputs.description: 覆盖采样帧率（帧/秒）；q(t) 未带 fps 时用作默认
inputs.description-en: Override sample rate (frames/second); also the default when q(t) omits fps.

inputs.name: loop
inputs.label: 循环
inputs.description: 是否循环播放（写入 clip.loop）
inputs.description-en: Whether the clip loops (written to clip.loop).

outputs.name: geometry
outputs.label: 几何
outputs.description: 追加 animation 语句后的 Geometry（校验失败时原样透传）
outputs.description-en: Geometry after appending the animation statement (passthrough on validation failure).

outputs.name: animation
outputs.label: 动画 clip
outputs.description: 已解析并夹取到限位的 JointAnimationClip（{ name, fps, frameCount, loop?, channels }）
outputs.description-en: Parsed and limit-clamped JointAnimationClip ({ name, fps, frameCount, loop?, channels }).

outputs.name: report
outputs.label: 报告
outputs.description: 结构化校验报告：fps / frameCount / durationSec / channelCount / movableJointCount / restingJointCount / clamped / warnings / errors
outputs.description-en: Structured validation report: fps / frameCount / durationSec / channelCount / movableJointCount / restingJointCount / clamped / warnings / errors.

outputs.name: error
outputs.label: 错误
outputs.description: 非致命错误信息（校验失败时返回，几何原样透传）
outputs.description-en: Non-fatal error string (returned on validation failure; geometry passes through unchanged).
